title: Activate Athena's Evidence-Gated Learning Frontier
winning_condition: A candidate policy improves a frozen held-out task set, survives a conjugate audit, preserves truth, privacy and safety, replays independently, and carries a tested rollback receipt.

roles.Square: Type goals, metrics, permissions and invariants.
roles.Cloud: Preserve uncertainty, alternatives, evidence and abstention.
roles.Fractal: Compress receipts, lineages and successor seeds.
roles.Watchdog: Search for real reward hacks; receives no quota for fabricated offenses.
roles.Witness: Independently replay candidates and validate held-out results.
